fact: The proclamation says about 720,000 people are enrolled in the NBIS, which is about 12.6% of Liberia's 5.7 million people (share computed from the held population figure).
Biometric Update says Liberia's national ID coverage is less than 15 percent of a population of more than five million.
NIR says it had enrolled 740,000 people by December 2024, about 13% of Liberia's 5.7 million (computed from the population given).
The NIR says 700,000 people (13.46% of 5.2 million) are enrolled in the NBIS.
